_about: Per-project settings for the Revit add-in. Copy to data/projects/<project>/revit/project.json (git-ignored).

service._about: The consultant's service space around a set, in mm. There is no legal figure (data/space/rules.csv, ANY-SPACE-SERVICE): these are the consultant's own.

circuit._about: Only when the model has no electrical circuit for the pump. Otherwise the model's circuit is used.

test_room._about: Optional: a room to build in an empty model with RightFit > Test Room. Origin at the room's south-west inner corner, x east, y north, mm.

pump.set: id of the set standing there (else the submitted one)
